notes.title: Early Access Patch April 19th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New models for most playable characters
[*] Purchasable updates have been fixed
[*] Surviving the given time gives players gold for reward
[*] Melee attack has been binded to Right Mouse Button (By default, you can change this in settings)
[*] Single ability can be used faster with Left Mouse button (By default, you can change this in settings) and gives players faster respond for this ability. You can shuffle the abilities with Middle Mouse Button.
[*] Playable characters have been renamed 
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Major Patch: Kolfjor
notes.content:
New major patch called Kolfjor adds two new playable heroes Valko the Frostbearer and Liisa the Spiritcaller with unique abilities to the game. There is also new map, Kolfjor that lets players explore the snowy mountains as they struggle to survive!

[list]
[*] New map: Kolfjor
[*] New hero: Valko the Frostbearer
[*] New hero: Liisa the Spiritcaller
[*] Enemy spawn lowered at the start of the game and gets increased as the game goes on
[*] Far away enemies despawn correctly, so no hidden enemies should stay behind
[*] Player melee attack has been corrected
[*] Fixed the bug where players health was not at 100% after getting an item to increase health
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch 0.245.8 & TUONELA Demo
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Animation changes for attack
[*] Character's base attack now deals low amount of damage for enemies close by
[*] Resting on campfire now shows banner on player once Attack Speed buff is active
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

TUONELA Demo is also now available for download. The Demo version is older 0.245.5 version and does not support multiplayer, upgrades or item purchases. Only Ravensbrook is unlocked map on the demo version.
